patterns: PYQs ask direct facts: Ellora built by Rashtrakutas; Ellora covers Hinduism, Buddhism and Jainism.
APPSC adds Ellora specifics: 34 caves (12-17-5), Kailasa = Cave 16, chronological ordering of named caves.
Common trap: Kailasa carved under Krishna I, not Dantidurga; Sulaiman = Amoghavarsha I, Al-Masudi = Indra III.
App covers administration, Arab travellers and AP link (Krishna III and Vengi) in more depth than PYQs; facts are sound.
